szoveg_eredeti:
The World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO) is a China-led intergovernmental initiative focused on shaping global artificial intelligence (AI) governance, promoting equitable development, and bridging technological divides across the Global South. Headquartered in Shanghai, the organization brings together member states to foster collaborative governance, coordinate policy frameworks, and advance open, safe, fair, and people-centered AI. The initiative seeks to ensure that the AI revolution empowers developing economies and broadens technical cooperation, countering fragmented national approaches through multilateral engagement.

Twenty-nine countries signed the founding agreement to establish WAICO in July 2026. Membership expanded quickly as new signatories joined from across Asia, Africa, the Middle East, Eastern Europe, and the Americas. The initiative now has 44 signatories and 45 participants overall, including Bangladesh, which has joined as an observer to engage with the body’s technical working groups and capacity-building programs.

The organization’s efforts focus on promoting open models, supporting inclusive technical capacity, and establishing cooperative norms for safe and orderly AI development. Through structured working groups on compute sharing, multilingual training models, and regulatory alignment, WAICO aims to institutionalize long-term technological cooperation among developing nations.
